long_biography.plain_text:
Gretel Packer began her philanthropic work as a founding governor of the Taronga Zoo Foundation in 2000. The role preceded the division of her father's estate and established a public commitment spanning conservation, education, community programmes and the arts.

As chair of the Packer Family Foundation, Packer helped establish a joint national fund with the Crown Resorts Foundation. Its partnerships supported Indigenous education, culture and community welfare. She also served as vice-president of the Art Gallery of New South Wales trustees and chaired the Sydney Theatre Company Foundation. Australia appointed her a Member of the Order of Australia in 2020 for service to the community, arts and conservation.
long_biography.html:
Gretel Packer began her philanthropic work as a founding governor of the Taronga Zoo Foundation in 2000. The role preceded the division of her father's estate and established a public commitment spanning conservation, education, community programmes and the arts.

As chair of the Packer Family Foundation, Packer helped establish a joint national fund with the Crown Resorts Foundation. Its partnerships supported Indigenous education, culture and community welfare. She also served as vice-president of the Art Gallery of New South Wales trustees and chaired the Sydney Theatre Company Foundation. Australia appointed her a Member of the Order of Australia in 2020 for service to the community, arts and conservation.
